title: An exhausted subscription is not capacity (#858)

story.i_want_to: a runner that declares its subscription exhausted to receive no work until its reset
story.so_that: dispatches stop burning slots on machines that cannot start a session, and the operator sees when capacity returns

rationale: Eligibility checks draining, repo and kind; the scarce resource is the subscription window, which nothing sees. A declared, clamped, persisted reset keeps exhausted machines out of placement without trusting a runner's arbitrary timestamp, and runners on one account are exhausted together.

acceptance_criteria.description: The status message accepts optional usage {exhausted, resets_at, account_ref}; a malformed usage object is refused invalid_payload.
exhausted: true persists usage_exhausted_until on the runners row, clamped to between now + 60s and now + 8 days.
exhausted: true without resets_at persists now + 8 days.
A runner with usage_exhausted_until in the future is not selected by the dispatch driver or the triage dispatcher.
Every runner in the tenant with the same account_ref is treated as exhausted until the latest declared reset for that account.
A status with exhausted: false clears usage_exhausted_until for that runner.
runner_pool shows usage_exhausted_until per runner and the driver's no_runner log names the earliest reset.

test_cases.name: reset is clamped
steps: push exhausted with resets_at 30 days out; then exhausted with no resets_at

test_cases.name: exhausted runner skipped
preconditions: two runners, one exhausted, a queued contracted story

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
steps: run tenant A's driver with its own runner on account_ref 'a'

technical_notes: Columns on runners: usage_exhausted_until utc_datetime, account_ref string (migration; set programmatically)
Eligibility: Runners.accepts?/5 (runners.ex:903) and the driver's available_runner selection
Contract: usage on the status message (1.15.0); a runner not sending it is unaffected
non_goals: Does not measure subscription usage itself
Does not schedule a wakeup at the reset time
